root_cause: Weak-spot audit found four critical/medium issues: pg-migrate.ts used DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() without guaranteeing pgcrypto; Application.start() and createHttpServer() treated OAuth/Klavis/A2A as hard startup dependencies; CORS was globally permissive and loopback-looking origins could bypass socket verification; Swift retry exhaustion leaked raw URLError and A2A SSE reconnection gave up silently; clade-build did not build QueenUILib and compiled broken untracked BR-OUTPUT prototypes.
fix_pattern: Removed pgcrypto-dependent default from agent_tasks and generate UUIDs in JS. Wrapped initCoreServices() and non-port createHttpServer() errors in warning-and-continue try/catch blocks; isolated OAuth/Klavis/A2A construction in per-feature guards. Replaced permissive CORS with an explicit allowlist and gated credentials. Tightened requireTrustedAppOrigin so spoofed loopback Origin headers from remote sockets are rejected. Added NetworkRetrier.execute(task:) overload mapping exhausted URLError to A2AError.transport; made A2ARegistryClient.messageStream() yield a synthetic error A2AMessage before finishing on reconnect exhaustion. Added Bun tests for DB retry/migration/auth and Swift tests for partial SSE chunks + typed retry exhaustion. Fixed clade-build to build QueenUILib first and compile only the lean BR-OUTPUT whitelist matching build.sh.
lessons: PostgreSQL schema defaults must not assume extensions are installed; either create the extension explicitly or generate IDs in application code.
Optional server features (OAuth, Klavis, A2A, OpenClaw) must each have their own guard so a misconfiguration in one does not crash the whole process.
CORS origin: true is dangerous with credentials; maintain an explicit allowlist and gate Access-Control-Allow-Credentials.
Loopback-looking Origin headers from remote sockets are a real bypass class; always verify the actual TCP socket.
Swift network actors should wrap exhausted retry errors into domain errors before they reach UI code.
A build tool that compiles the app must mirror the canonical build exactly, including dependency order and source whitelist, or untracked prototypes break CI.
